title: Lakshya Sen Dominates Toma Popov, Enters Hylo Open Final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen has secured his spot in the Hylo Open final after a convincing straight-games victory.
summary: Lakshya now moves into the final, where he will play top-seed Anders Antonsen of Denmark or Jonatan Christie of Indonesia, the fourth seed for the Hylo Open title.

title: India's Sindhu, Lakshya Both Reach Hylo Open Finals
